integrity: A complete parameter-uniform simplicial orbit-complex and homotopy-pushout proof accompanies a standalone finite checker; finite checks do not replace the proof.
scientific_limitations: The result classifies the geometric fixed points only for weight-three translations at inclusive Hamming scale three, for all n>=4; it does not give full equivariant homotopy type, other subgroup fixed points, or new ambient homology characters.
title: Weight-three translation fixed spaces in hypercube Vietoris–Rips complexes
